question: What product version did Netsertive launch in August 2026?

hits.title: Netsertive announces the latest ai-native version of MLX, introduces version 3.0 of its Multi-Location Experience Platform.
hits.snippet: Netsertive announces the latest ai-native version of MLX, introduces version 3.0 of its Multi-Location Experience Platform.

hits.title: Head To Toe Brands and Netsertive drive multi-brand growth, powered by back-end technology and systems integrations.
hits.snippet: Head To Toe and Netsertive recently completed a CRM and Multi-Location Experience (MLX) Platform integration, which connects digital advertising efforts directly to unit-level business outcomes, allowing the Home Office and franchisees to see exactly how digital marketing spend translates into revenue.

hits.snippet: MORRISVILLE, N.C., March 9, 2026 (Newswire.com) - Netsertive, a marketing technology platform provider for multi-location and franchise brands, has once again achieved Premier Partner status in the Google Partners program.

hits.snippet: Netsertive, a marketing technology platform provider for multi-location and franchise brands, announced today it was named a winner in three categories of the 2026 Stevie(R) Awards.

extract.answer: Version 3.0 of its Multi-Location Experience (MLX) Platform.

accuracy.note: Answer states MLX Platform version 3.0, equivalent to MLX 3.0

ar.note: Snippet 1 explicitly names version 3.0 of Netsertive's MLX (Multi-Location Experience) Platform; others mention unrelated awards/integrations.
